name: South Africa

flag.description: A green horizontal Y shape edged in white and gold, whose arms open toward the hoist around a black triangle edged in gold, with a red band above and a blue band below.
flag.symbolism: No official meaning is given, but the Y shape is commonly read as diverse elements converging and moving forward together.

hook: South Africa's sideways green Y merges two paths into one road, with a black triangle at the hoist and red above, blue below.
trivia: The flag was designed by Frederick Brownell just weeks before the 1994 election and was meant to be temporary.
South Africa has three capital cities, one for each branch of government.
